import os,struct,hashlib,itertools,string,json,gzip,base64,xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
from Crypto.Cipher import AES,Salsa20
p=next(os.path.join('store/jobs/j000078/out',x) for x in os.listdir('store/jobs/j000078/out') if x.endswith('.dat'))
b=open(p,'rb').read(); assert b[:8]==bytes.fromhex('03d9a29a67fb4bb5')
ver=struct.unpack('<I',b[8:12])[0]; pos=12; fields={}
while True:
 fid=b[pos]; ln=struct.unpack('<H',b[pos+1:pos+3])[0]; val=b[pos+3:pos+3+ln];pos+=3+ln
 fields[fid]=val
 if fid==0:break
seed=fields[5]; rounds=struct.unpack('<Q',fields[6])[0]; master=fields[4]; iv=fields[7]; start=fields[9]
chars=string.printable[:-6]  # 94 printable non-whitespace ASCII
# known positions 1..14; chars 0 and 4 unknown
known='i&Y'+'{}'+'Q)8h<)1T2j'
cands=[]; buf=bytearray()
for a,c in itertools.product(chars,repeat=2):
 pw=a+known.format(c)
 cands.append(pw); buf += hashlib.sha256(hashlib.sha256(pw.encode()).digest()).digest()
cipher=AES.new(seed,AES.MODE_ECB); x=bytes(buf)
for r in range(rounds): x=cipher.encrypt(x)
found=[]
enc=b[pos:]
for i,pw in enumerate(cands):
 tr=hashlib.sha256(x[i*32:(i+1)*32]).digest(); key=hashlib.sha256(master+tr).digest()
 dec=AES.new(key,AES.MODE_CBC,iv).decrypt(enc)
 if dec[:32]==start: found.append((pw,key,dec))
if len(found)!=1: raise SystemExit('matches='+str(len(found)))
pw,key,dec=found[0]
# Remove start, parse hashed blocks
q=32; parts=[]
while True:
 idx=struct.unpack('<I',dec[q:q+4])[0]; h=dec[q+4:q+36]; n=struct.unpack('<I',dec[q+36:q+40])[0]; data=dec[q+40:q+40+n]; q+=40+n
 if n==0: break
 assert hashlib.sha256(data).digest()==h
 parts.append(data)
payload=b''.join(parts)
if struct.unpack('<I',fields[3])[0]==1: payload=gzip.decompress(payload)
open(os.environ['OUT']+'/database.xml','wb').write(payload)
root=ET.fromstring(payload)
# decrypt protected values in XML document order
salsa=Salsa20.new(key=hashlib.sha256(fields[8]).digest(),nonce=bytes.fromhex('e830094b97205d2a'))
entries=[]
for e in root.iter('Entry'):
 row={}
 for s in e.findall('String'):
  k=s.findtext('Key',''); v=s.find('Value'); text=v.text or ''
  if v.get('Protected')=='True':
   raw=base64.b64decode(text); text=salsa.decrypt(raw).decode('utf-8','replace')
  row[k]=text
 # identify ancestor is hard ET; include UUID, deletion time/history flags later
 row['_uuid']=e.findtext('UUID',''); entries.append(row)
out={'kdbx_version':hex(ver),'rounds':rounds,'password':pw,'password_md5':hashlib.md5(pw.encode()).hexdigest(),'entries':entries}
open(os.environ['OUT']+'/result.json','w').write(json.dumps(out,indent=2))
print(json.dumps(out,indent=2))
